Part of **New page: Strategy** (72986e081ef982d9).

Project: `solace-cli/strategy`, maybe `solace-cli/components`. Needs "Strategy run store and API", "Strategy: launching the agent and reading the graph" and "Strategy: proposals and approval".

title: Strategy: planning panel
